source: Helber et al., DOI 10.1109/JSTARS.2019.2918242; phelber/EuroSAT RGB class taxonomy
notes: Independently authored static visible attributes; not image-level ground truth. Paraphrase uses an alternate overhead framing. No query outcomes used.

annualcrop.core: An aerial image of annual cropland.
attrs: Open cultivated parcels fill the overhead view.
Crop rows create fine repeated marks.
Field edges break the land into managed blocks.
paraphrase: From overhead, open cultivated parcels fill the overhead view.
From overhead, crop rows create fine repeated marks.
From overhead, field edges break the land into managed blocks.
